content: Integrated official command-line TXA Package Manager (txapm).
Added advanced tuning & optimization suite: NTLite, RAMMap64, NVIDIA Profile Inspector, Chris Titus WinUtil, MSI Util v3, Timer Resolution.
Brand new NSIS installer: Multilingual (Vietnamese & English), Fluent Dark Blue styling with glowing tech banners.
Smart conflict handling and safe in-place overwrite upgrade mode.
Auto-updater integration powered by txa.yml format.
Dedicated VietQR donation card & popup supporting TXA.
Distinct routing for Software Store (txavl.github.io/txa-repo) and Documentation (txavl.github.io/txa-repo/docs/).
